body: This is an oversight that needs to be fixed. The original obstacle had only a fake avoidance agent with a radius and all those settings update that agent. The static obstacle vertices has its own code branch and when the navigation map rebuilds the static obstacles rvo simulation tree it does not look at their `avoidance_enabled` state to ignore disabled obstacles. E.g. inside the NavMap2D and NavMap3D where it rebuilds the rvo obstacles it should ignore those that are not enabled. The other way is to add it directly to the rvo avoidance like with the avoidance layers but that would require a new hack to the third-party rvo lib. It is simpler to do it the other way by not adding the obstacles when the navigation map rebuilds the avoidance simulation tree.
